spec.name: Reversal v5
spec.notes: High turnover by design: the reversal edge is measured net of 10 bps per unit of turnover.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.5, annual return 13%, maximum drawdown 4%.

exhibits: The research log indicates only 5 trials were performed, which is insufficient to establish the robustness of a high-turnover reversal strategy.

verdict.opinion: The strategy relies on a simple reversal signal with high turnover. While the cost assumption of 10 bps is reasonable, the research log shows only 5 trials were conducted. This is statistically insufficient to rule out data mining or to confirm that the strategy is not a result of a lucky period. Given the high turnover nature of the strategy, execution slippage and market impact are significant risks that are not fully captured in the backtest. I recommend paper trading to verify that the signal holds up under real-time execution conditions before committing capital.
